GameUI_Orders_PickDesc: "The crown sends you new orders, viceroy. Pick one, and the rest will go to the other settlements."
GameUI_OrdersPopup_EtherealTooltip_Desc: This order option will disappear if you decide to unpause the game before choosing it.
GameUI_PaymentsPopup_AutoPayment_Tooltip: You can set your payment to be automatically paid by your Royal Treasurer. "Instant" means that payment will be made as soon as there are enough resources in the Main Warehouse. "Last minute" means that the payment will be made just before the deadline. You can set a default value for all of the new payments in the Options menu (under the gameplay tab).
GameUI_PaymentsPopup_Dialogue_Text: "May the sun shine on you, Viceroy! I was sent here to help you keep track of all these annoying payments and obligations. Another pair of eyes on your Exploration Tax forms might come in handy."
GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_Button_Tooltip: Forging a cornerstone will consume one Thunderblight Shard. You can only forge 3 cornerstones in one settlement.
GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_FinishedText: No more cornerstones can be forged
GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_NegativePick: Choose a penalty to upgrade a connected effect or condition.
GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_NPC_ActiveDialog: Ah, just what this flame-forsaken wasteland needed - another Viceroy. If you want a cornerstone, bring me a Thunderblight Shard, and I'll make you one.
GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_NPC_UsedDialogue: Sorry, no can do - three Cornerstones is the limit. Royal decree, something about "protecting the land"... you know how it is.
GameUI_PerkCrafterPanel_Tooltip_Desc: To create a cornerstone, you must choose a condition and a reward/effect. The effect stacks based on how many times the condition is triggered. Both conditions and effects have a random rating (stars). You can choose an optional penalty to increase the rating of either the condition or the effect (indicated by a line connecting the penalty to one of them). Finally, you need to choose an icon and name your new cornerstone.
GameUI_PerksPickPopup_Desc: "No one can weather the storm alone. The Queen offers you a cornerstone that will lay the foundation for your town's prosperity. Choose wisely, as you won't be able to change it."
GameUI_PerksPickPopup_Reroll_Tooltip: Each settlement only has a limited number of cornerstone rerolls. More can be acquired by buying upgrades in the Smoldering City.
GameUI_PerksPickPopup_SealedBiomeExtra_D: You are one step closer to reforging the seal. My gifts may not be as powerful as the Queen's, but nevertheless, I offer you a Cornerstone as a reward.
GameUI_PerksPickPopup_SkipButton_Tooltip: You can decline a cornerstone to receive Amber instead. Each time you do, the reward decreases by 2 Amber, down to a minimum of 5.
GameUI_PoroFullTooltip_Desc: The Fluffbeak's pasture is full of manure.
GameUI_PoroPanel_Fertilizer_Tooltip_Desc: The Fluffbeak will produce fertilizer if it feels well enough and its pasture is not full of manure.
GameUI_PoroPanel_Needs_Tooltip_Desc: A healthy, happy Fluffbeak is a symbol of prosperity, and a source of pride for your villagers. By providing the right goods to the Giant Fluffbeak, you'll meet its needs and boost its overall well-being.
GameUI_PoroPanel_PayButton_Tooltip_Desc: Each portion increases the fulfillment of this need by 25%.
GameUI_PoroUnhappyTooltip_Desc: The Fluffbeak is too unhappy to produce fertilizer.
GameUI_PortPanel_ButtonTooltip_Cancel: An expedition cannot be canceled once the Strider has left the docks.
GameUI_PortPanel_ExtraRewards_Tooltip_De: These waters hold many secrets. The more supplies you provide, the longer the Strider will search, and the better your chances of finding a higher rarity treasure chest.
GameUI_PortPanel_Requirements_Tooltip_De: Before sending out an expedition, you must supply both the Water Strider and its rider with food. You can also use more supplies to increase your chances of getting a higher rarity treasure chest.
GameUI_PortPanel_Rewards_Tooltip_Desc: Expeditions alternate between two types: blueprint expeditions and treasure expeditions. Blueprint expeditions give you a blueprint and a treasure chest, while treasure expeditions offer only a treasure chest, but with a higher chance of getting a higher rarity one. Investing more supplies increases the likelihood of finding higher-rarity chests.
GameUI_PortPanel_Time_Tooltip_Desc: Each expedition has a set duration, and you won't receive the rewards until it's completed. Investing more supplies for a higher chance of finding a rare reward will also increase the expedition's duration.

GameUI_RainpunkPanel_Desc: The Rain Engine control panel allows you to increase production capabilities and improve working conditions using infused rainwater. However, be aware that using rainwater will cause Blightrot to gradually spread throughout the city. The more infused rainwater is used, the quicker the spread of Blightrot.

GameUI_RelicPanel_Decision_Tooltip_Desc: Some events can be resolved in more than one way, and each option has different requirements and rewards. Some decisions are marked with special keywords (like "Empathy"), and these in turn affect certain perks and orders.
GameUI_RelicPanel_Requirements_Tooltip_D: To complete an event, you must deliver specific goods, or withstand a period of hostile effects while the event is being worked on. Sometimes both of these requirements apply.

GameUI_RelicPanel_Rewards_Tooltip_Desc: After scouts clear an event, they will return to a Warehouse with the goods looted from it. Rewards such as Reputation Points and perks don't need to be transported.
GameUI_ReputationBar_SealedBiomeMarker_T: This game cannot be won by earning Reputation. You must find and close the seal.
GameUI_ReputationRewardPopup_Desc: "Your renown grows. You can now choose from one of the available blueprints that the Queen offers you."
GameUI_ReputationRewardPopup_Desc_Tutori: Each expedition starts with only a few essential blueprints. More will be given to you as you gain Reputation Points. Now, pick the Woodcutters' Camp.
GameUI_ReputationRewardPopup_ExtendToolt: In exchange for payment, the Queen's Envoy will provide an additional option for your current pick. Rerolling will also reshuffle this extra option.
GameUI_ReputationRewardPopup_RerollButto: Pay to bribe the envoy and get a new set of blueprints to choose from
GameUI_ReputationRewardPopup_Tooltip_Des: Some Reputation Points you gain allow you to select a new building blueprint. You can unlock new blueprints by leveling up.

GameUI_RewardsPack_MysteryBox_WE_Desc: You crack open the box, wondering if it holds treasure… or if you’ve just been tricked.
GameUI_RewardsPack_SunkenTreasure_Desc: As you pry open the algae-covered, weighty treasure chest, it reveals its long-kept secrets.
GameUI_SaveFailPopup_Desc: An error occurred while trying to create a save file. Please make sure that there is enough space on your system drive and that no other process is trying to modify the save, then try again.
GameUI_SaveSupportPopup_Description: The current cycle needs to be restarted, as the old save is no longer compatible. Your Citadel and main progress will always remain intact!
GameUI_SaveSupportPopup_Game_Description: Due to a recent update, your settlement data was reset. This happens because we're constantly improving Against the Storm, and in order to keep delivering big, meaningful updates on a regular basis, we sometimes need to invalidate your game save. Here are the rewards you would have got for finishing the run. The upgrades in your Citadel remain intact.
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_1: The seal opens, unleashing the vengeful monstrosities trapped beneath. Hungry for revenge, they unleash plagues on the settlement with every storm. Your only chance of success is to collect four parts of the Ancient Guardian and close it. For each part, you must complete only one of the three objectives.
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_2: You have the Guardian's Heart, but you still have a long way to go... Choose your next steps wisely. Time is ticking, and as the years go by, the Sealed Ones will unleash even more terrible plagues upon the settlement. May the Holy Flame protect you!
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_3: The Blood of the Guardian already flows in its heart. Now we need something that will help it rise high above this evil land. With its countenance, it will shield our world from the terrors of the depths. Maybe I'll finally get to see it... for the first time, with my own eyes.
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_4: The Guardian begins to take shape. All that is left is to breathe a living, spiritual essence into it, so that it will finally rise and defeat our enemies with the power it has torn from them. People have regained hope, although they suffer more than ever. They still believe in you. Don't fail us now!
GameUI_SealPanel_Dialogue_Final: Thank you, Viceroy. You not only saved our world, but also rekindled the flame of hope in our people - the faith in something that until now was only a legend of old. Now I can finally rest... Take care. We will meet again, I'm sure. Be always on your guard, for evil never rests.

The royal guards were surprised, but more by your stupidity than anything else. While some goods were stolen in the confusion, your villagers were slaughtered like cattle.
